'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
* [[Iran–Israel proxy conflict]]
** An [[Israel]]i [[cargo vessel]] travelling towards the [[United Arab Emirates]] in the northern [[Indian Ocean]] is struck by an "unknown weapon" and damaged. No one has claimed responsibility for the attack, but [[Iran]] is blamed. [https://www.jpost.com/breaking-news/israeli-cargo-ship-hit-by-unknown-weapon-in-indian-ocean-report-672777 (''Jerusalem Post'')]
*[[Israel-Gaza conflict]]
** In response to arson balloons launched from the Gaza Strip into Israel, the [[Israeli Air Force]] strikes [[Hamas]] military targets in Gaza. [https://www.i24news.tv/en/news/israel/diplomacy-defense/1625345244-israel-strikes-gaza-terrorist-targets-in-retaliation-for-incendiary-balloon-attacks (i24NEWS)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on aviation]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in Argentina]]
**[[Aerolíneas Argentinas]] and [[low-cost carrier]] [[Flybondi]] resume [[domestic flight]]s in [[Argentina]] after a 15 month suspension due to [[COVID-19]] restrictions. The first flights to resume are between [[Córdoba, Argentina|Córdoba]] and the southern city of [[Bariloche]], and from Córdoba and [[Rosario, Argentina|Rosario]] to [[San Martín de los Andes]]. [https://es.mercopress.com/2021/07/03/flybondi-reanuda-servicios-tras-las-restricciones-causadas-por-la-pandemia-en-argentina (MercoPress)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2021 Atami landslide]]
**Two people are killed and at least 20 others are missing after [[mudslide]]s damage dozens of houses in [[Atami]], [[Shizuoka Prefecture]], Japan. The [[Japan Self-Defense Forces|military]] is deployed to the area as [[Prime Minister of Japan|Prime Minister]] [[Yoshihide Suga]] organizes an emergency task team. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-57704967 (BBC News)]
*[[European migrant crisis]]
**At least 43 migrants die in the [[Mediterranean Sea]] during a [[List of migrant vessel incidents on the Mediterranean Sea|shipwreck]]. The boat had departed from [[Zuwara]], [[Libya]], carrying migrants from [[Egypt]], [[Sudan]], [[Eritrea]] and [[Bangladesh]]. Eighty-four others were rescued, according to the [[Red Crescent]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/least-43-migrants-drown-shipwreck-off-tunisia-red-crescent-says-2021-07-03/ (Reuters)]
*[[2021 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**[[Hurricane Elsa]] downgrades to a Tropical Storm and heads towards the [[Dominican Republic]] and [[Haiti]] followed by [[Cuba]], the [[Cayman Islands]], [[Jamaica]] and the U.S. state of [[Florida]]. Heavy rains and high winds are expected. [https://edition.cnn.com/2021/07/03/weather/hurricane-elsa-saturday/index.html (CNN)]
'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Indonesia]]
****[[Community Activities Restrictions Enforcement]]
*****[[Indonesia]] begins to implement emergency community restrictions in most cities and [[Regency (Indonesia)|regencies]] in the islands of [[Java]] and [[Bali]], requiring non-essential businesses and [[Place of worship|places of worship]] to close as well as requiring a vaccination card for domestic travel as part of measures to reduce the spread of COVID-19. [https://www.kompas.com/tren/read/2021/07/03/060300065/berlaku-hari-ini-berikut-aturan-lengkap-ppkm-darurat-jawa-bali (''Kompas'')]
****Indonesia reports a record for the fourth consecutive day of 27,913 new cases of COVID-19, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 2.25 million. [https://health.detik.com/berita-detikhealth/d-5629850/dki-nyaris-10-ribu-ini-sebaran-27913-kasus-baru-covid-19-ri-3-juli (detikHealth)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in India]]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in India]]
*****Phase-III trials of the [[Covaxin]] vaccine from [[India]]'s [[Bharat Biotech]] showed a 65.2% efficacy against the [[Delta variant]], a 77.8% efficacy against symptomatic COVID-19, and a 93.4% efficacy against severe COVID-19. [https://www.khaleejtimes.com/coronavirus-pandemic/covid-vaccine-indias-covaxin-934-effective-against-severe-infection (Khaleej Times)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Malaysia]]
****[[Malaysian movement control order]]
*****[[Malaysia]] imposes an enhanced movement control order in 34 [[Mukim|mukim]]s in [[Selangor]] and 14 localities in [[Kuala Lumpur]] that would not allow residents to leave their home after 8:00 p.m. except for emergency reasons. The EMCO is in effect until July 16. [https://www.theedgemarkets.com/article/emco-several-subdistricts-and-localities-selangor-and-kl-only-food-daily-necessity-product (The Edge Markets)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Tajikistan]]
****[[Tajikistan]] becomes the first country to make [[COVID-19 vaccine|COVID-19 vaccinations]] mandatory for adults. [https://tass.com/world/1310239 (TASS)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Vietnam]]
****[[Vietnam]] reports a record 922 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 19,043. [https://vietnamnews.vn/society/985492/viet-nam-sees-record-high-daily-increase-of-covid-19-cases-on-saturday.html (Vietnam News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Australia]]
****[[COVID-19 lockdowns|Lockdown]] restrictions are lifted in [[Perth]] and surrounding towns after a decrease in the number of new cases. Masks are still mandatory in indoor settings, private gatherings are limited to 10 people, and public gatherings are limited to 20 people. Restrictions also lift in [[Brisbane]]. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2021-07-02/perth-post-covid-lockdown-rules-explained/100264634 (ABC Australia)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Fiji]]
****The test positivity rate in [[Fiji]] increases to 9.5% amid an increase in the number of cases since the April outbreak. The country has so far reported 5,253 [[COVID-19]] cases as the opposition [[National Federation Party]] condemns the alleged mishandling of the pandemic. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/446084/fiji-covid-19-5-more-deaths-404-new-cases (RNZ)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Russia]]
***[[Russia]] reports a record for the fifth consecutive day of 697 [[COVID-19 pandemic deaths|deaths]] from COVID-19, thereby bringing the nationwide death toll to 137,262. [https://www.barrons.com/articles/russia-reports-record-covid-deaths-for-fifth-straight-day-01625301006 (''Barron's'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in South Africa]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in South Africa]]
***The [[South African Health Products Regulatory Authority]] approves the usage of the [[Coronavac]] vaccine made by [[Sinovac]] under certain conditions. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2021-07-03/south-africa-approves-sinovac-s-covid-19-vaccine (Bloomberg)]

'''Law and crime'''
*A court in the [[Holy See]] [[indict]]s ten people, including [[Cardinal (Catholic Church)|Cardinal]] [[Giovanni Angelo Becciu]], on [[embezzlement]], [[money laundering]], [[fraud]], [[extortion]] and abuse of office. [[Pope Francis]] personally approved the indictments. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/vatican-judge-indicts-10-including-cardinal-alleged-financial-crimes-2021-07-03/ (Reuters)]
